deliverables: Custodial wallet onboarding inside Sellout flow
Independent third-party smart-contract audit with published remediation
Public launch campaign and trade-show activations
Public metrics dashboard and quarterly reporting
request.recipient: Intersect as budget administrator for disbursement through the Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC framework, with Anvil/Sellout delivering the project.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Phase 2 of a Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency.

claims.claim: Phase 1 is already live on Cardano mainnet with on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification funded by Sellout with over $130,000 invested.
The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, stated as approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, inclusive of a 3% Intersect administration fee, over 8 months with milestone-gated disbursements.
Phase 2 will deliver a secondary ticket marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, an independent audit, and launch amplification.
Sellout has 200,000+ registered users, has issued 250,000+ tickets to date, and currently supports 350+ events annually.

The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is presented as a contracted anchor deployment projected to move over $6 million through Cardano in Year 1, based on $5.88 million in 2025 historical activity.
The project targets 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ CIP-68 NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6 million+ ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets within 12 months from launch.

The proposer commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism where 25% of fees are paid until full reimbursement and 5% thereafter, with exact definitions finalized in M1 contracting.
The proposal states that unused contingency funds of about 136,363 ada will be returned to the Treasury at project completion.
On-chain metrics are said to be independently verifiable through Cardano explorer data and policy-ID tracking, with a public dashboard planned for M5 and quarterly Cardano Forum reports.
The proposal states that the requested withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350 million ada Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at submission time.

summary: The proposal seeks 4,969,231 ada for an 8-month, milestone-gated enterprise ticketing rollout with stated adoption targets, repayment mechanisms, oversight arrangements, and public reporting commitments, but many key commercial and adoption assertions are proposer-stated rather than evidenced in the supplied document.
